en.title: Took too many sleeping pills
en.description: An old man on the sidewalk in King's took "a handful" of his sleeping pills because he could not sleep. He is confused and keeps nodding off.

hu.title: Túl sok altatót vett be
hu.description: King's járdáján egy idős férfi „egy maréknyi” altatót vett be, mert nem tudott aludni. Zavart, és újra meg újra elbóbiskol.
